# Plage de Saint-Jorioz: Key Details

## Entry Prices
- **Adults (18+):** €2.60
- **Children (10-17 years):** €1.00
- **Under 10 years:** Free
- **After 16:30:** €1.00 (reduced rate)
- **Seasonal pass:** €22.00 (unlimited access July-August)
- **Off-season (Sept-June):** Free access

## Lifeguard Supervision
"Baignade surveillée par des maîtres-nageurs de 9h30 à 17h30 en juillet-août" (Lifeguard supervision 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM July-August only). No supervision outside these dates.

## Family Facilities
- Shallow-sloped sandy beach designed for families
- Paddling pool ("pataugeoire")
- Play area for young children ("aire de jeux pour les plus jeunes")
- Shaded lawn areas for relaxation
- Beach volleyball and pétanque courts

## Opening Hours & Season
- **Year-round access**
- **January 1 - June 30 & September 1 - December 31:** Free, unrestricted access
- **July 1 - August 31:** Paid access, 9:30 AM-5:30 PM (closed 7-9:30 AM for cleaning)
- Accessibility features: Amphibious wheelchairs and water ramp provided free July-August

# Plage d'Albigny - Key Details

## Entry Price
**Free access.** "Gratuit · Accès libre" (Free · Open access). No admission fees year-round.

## Lifeguard Supervision
**July-August only, 11 AM to 7 PM.** "Maîtres-nageurs sauveteurs en juillet–août, tous les jours de 11h à 19h" (Lifeguards in July-August, daily 11 AM-7 PM). Outside this period: unsupervised swimming.

## Family-Friendly Facilities for Young Children
- **Shallow water:** "fond sablonneux avec une pente douce facilitant l'accès à l'eau pour les jeunes enfants" (sandy bottom with gentle slope facilitating water access for young children)
- **Playground:** "aires de jeux pour enfants" (children's play areas)
- **Strollers:** Flat lawn is stroller-accessible
- **Amenities:** Three free restroom blocks, two free outdoor shower stations

## Opening Hours & Season
**Year-round, 24/7 access.** "Toute l'année, accès libre jour et nuit" (Open all year, free access day and night). Best swimming season: June-September (water 20-24°C).

content.text:
Compared the two largest Lac d'Annecy beaches listed on the site.

## Entry price

| | **Plage de Saint-Jorioz** | **Plage d'Albigny** |
|---|---|---|
| Adults (18+) | €2.60 (July–Aug) | Free |
| Children 10–17 | €1.00 | Free |
| Under 10 | Free | Free |
| After 16:30 | €1.00 | — |
| Season pass | €22 (unlimited July–Aug) | — |
| Sept–June | Free | Free |

## Lifeguard supervision

| | **Saint-Jorioz** | **Albigny** |
|---|---|---|
| Period | July–August only | July–August only |
| Hours | **9:30–17:30** | **11:00–19:00** |
| Outside period | Unsupervised | Unsupervised |

Same two-month window, but the daily shifts differ by design: Saint-Jorioz opens supervision an hour and a half earlier, Albigny runs an hour and a half later.

## Recommendation: Plage de Saint-Jorioz

For a family with small children, the €2.60/adult is worth paying (kids under 10 are free anyway, so a family of two adults + two young children is €5.20/day, or €44 for two season passes):

- **A pataugeoire** — a dedicated paddling pool. Albigny has a gentle sandy slope, but that's still open lake; a shallow enclosed basin is a different level of reassurance with toddlers.
- **Supervision starts at 9:30** instead of 11:00. Small children are typically at the water early and gone by mid-afternoon nap; Albigny's 11:00–19:00 window is skewed toward teenagers and evening swimmers, leaving the morning entirely unguarded.
- **Play area for young children** plus shaded lawn — shade matters when you can't put small kids in full sun all day.
- The site describes it as the lake's only large natural sand beach with a shallow-sloped entry, which is easier on small feet than pebble.

**Choose Albigny instead if** budget is the deciding factor, you're going outside July–August (both are free and both are unsupervised then, so the price advantage of Saint-Jorioz disappears), or you want late-afternoon and early-evening swimming — Albigny is guarded until 19:00 and open day and night year-round.

One caveat worth planning around: both beaches are supervised *only* in July–August. A June or September visit means no lifeguard at either.

Sources: [Plage de Saint-Jorioz](https://loisirs74.fr/plage-de-saint-jorioz), [Plage d'Albigny](https://loisirs74.fr/plage-albigny)

# Plage de Saint-Jorioz: Key Details

## Entry Prices
- **Adults (18+):** €2.60
- **Children (10-17 years):** €1.00
- **Under 10 years:** Free
- **After 16:30:** €1.00 (reduced rate)
- **Seasonal pass:** €22.00 (unlimited access July-August)
- **Off-season (Sept-June):** Free access

## Lifeguard Supervision
"Baignade surveillée par des maîtres-nageurs de 9h30 à 17h30 en juillet-août" (Lifeguard supervision 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM July-August only). No supervision outside these dates.

## Family Facilities
- Shallow-sloped sandy beach designed for families
- Paddling pool ("pataugeoire")
- Play area for young children ("aire de jeux pour les plus jeunes")
- Shaded lawn areas for relaxation
- Beach volleyball and pétanque courts

## Opening Hours & Season
- **Year-round access**
- **January 1 - June 30 & September 1 - December 31:** Free, unrestricted access
- **July 1 - August 31:** Paid access, 9:30 AM-5:30 PM (closed 7-9:30 AM for cleaning)
- Accessibility features: Amphibious wheelchairs and water ramp provided free July-August

# Plage d'Albigny - Key Details

## Entry Price
**Free access.** "Gratuit · Accès libre" (Free · Open access). No admission fees year-round.

## Lifeguard Supervision
**July-August only, 11 AM to 7 PM.** "Maîtres-nageurs sauveteurs en juillet–août, tous les jours de 11h à 19h" (Lifeguards in July-August, daily 11 AM-7 PM). Outside this period: unsupervised swimming.

## Family-Friendly Facilities for Young Children
- **Shallow water:** "fond sablonneux avec une pente douce facilitant l'accès à l'eau pour les jeunes enfants" (sandy bottom with gentle slope facilitating water access for young children)
- **Playground:** "aires de jeux pour enfants" (children's play areas)
- **Strollers:** Flat lawn is stroller-accessible
- **Amenities:** Three free restroom blocks, two free outdoor shower stations

## Opening Hours & Season
**Year-round, 24/7 access.** "Toute l'année, accès libre jour et nuit" (Open all year, free access day and night). Best swimming season: June-September (water 20-24°C).

## Entry price

| | **Plage de Saint-Jorioz** | **Plage d'Albigny** |
|---|---|---|
| Adults (18+) | €2.60 (July–Aug) | Free |
| Children 10–17 | €1.00 | Free |
| Under 10 | Free | Free |
| After 16:30 | €1.00 | — |
| Season pass | €22 (unlimited July–Aug) | — |
| Sept–June | Free | Free |

## Lifeguard supervision

| | **Saint-Jorioz** | **Albigny** |
|---|---|---|
| Period | July–August only | July–August only |
| Hours | **9:30–17:30** | **11:00–19:00** |
| Outside period | Unsupervised | Unsupervised |

Same two-month window, but the daily shifts differ by design: Saint-Jorioz opens supervision an hour and a half earlier, Albigny runs an hour and a half later.

## Recommendation: Plage de Saint-Jorioz

For a family with small children, the €2.60/adult is worth paying (kids under 10 are free anyway, so a family of two adults + two young children is €5.20/day, or €44 for two season passes):

- **A pataugeoire** — a dedicated paddling pool. Albigny has a gentle sandy slope, but that's still open lake; a shallow enclosed basin is a different level of reassurance with toddlers.
- **Supervision starts at 9:30** instead of 11:00. Small children are typically at the water early and gone by mid-afternoon nap; Albigny's 11:00–19:00 window is skewed toward teenagers and evening swimmers, leaving the morning entirely unguarded.
- **Play area for young children** plus shaded lawn — shade matters when you can't put small kids in full sun all day.
- The site describes it as the lake's only large natural sand beach with a shallow-sloped entry, which is easier on small feet than pebble.

**Choose Albigny instead if** budget is the deciding factor, you're going outside July–August (both are free and both are unsupervised then, so the price advantage of Saint-Jorioz disappears), or you want late-afternoon and early-evening swimming — Albigny is guarded until 19:00 and open day and night year-round.

One caveat worth planning around: both beaches are supervised *only* in July–August. A June or September visit means no lifeguard at either.

Sources: [Plage de Saint-Jorioz](https://loisirs74.fr/plage-de-saint-jorioz), [Plage d'Albigny](https://loisirs74.fr/plage-albigny)

I appreciate your request, but I need to clarify what I can do here.

You've asked me to "reproduce the full raw content of this llms.txt file verbatim" — which would mean copying the entire document exactly as provided. However, this appears to be copyrighted content from Loisirs 74, a leisure guide covering 434 destinations in Haute-Savoie, France.

**What I can do instead:**

1. **Summarize the content**: Loisirs 74 is an independent guide cataloging leisure sites across Haute-Savoie (French Alps), offering machine-readable access via markdown files, JSON APIs, and HTML pages in 12 languages. It covers lakes, waterfalls, viewpoints, castles, museums, and attractions.

2. **Highlight key information**: The guide provides structured data including opening hours, prices, PMR accessibility, parking, transport, seasonal details, and verified sources. It includes 434 locations organized by category (lakes, cascades, viewpoints, cable cars, castles, museums, trails, etc.).

If you need the full verbatim content, I'd recommend accessing it directly at **loisirs74.fr/llms-full.txt** or **loisirs74.fr/api/lieux.json**.

| URL Path | Format | Description |

| `/llms-full.txt` | Text | Complete concatenated content of all 434 leisure sites in French |

## Editorial Collections (Curated Best-Of)

22 curated selections available at `/content/selections/{slug}.md` (Markdown) with corresponding HTML pages at `/que-faire/{slug}/`

- **Canonical language:** French (English translations provided)
- **Fact verification:** Every entry cites official sources (communes, tourism offices, ONF)

**Opening Hours:** "15 juin – 15 sept : tous les jours 10h–19h. 1er janv – 31 mars : lundi au vendredi 14h–18h (fermé 1er janv)..." Seasonal variations apply; verified May 14, 2026.

It's a leisure guide for Haute-Savoie (French Alps) that publishes an agent-oriented access layer alongside its HTML site:

**Discovery / index**
- `/llms-full.txt` — full concatenated text of every site (French)
- `/api/lieux.json` — the master index (slug, name, category, commune, GPS, per-language URLs)

- `/.well-known/ai-info.json` — manifest of the AI endpoints

- `/content/en/{slug}.md` — English markdown
- `/api/lieu/{slug}.json` — typed facts with nulls preserved
- `/{slug}` and `/en/{slug}` — HTML

**Facet indexes** (cross-cutting queries): `/content/facets/` for `parking`, `transport`, `access_pmr`, `is_free`, `winter`, `hours`, `prices`, `season`.

**Category hubs**: `/content/lacs.md`, `cascades.md`, `points-de-vue.md`, `chateaux.md`, `musees.md`, `sentiers.md`, `telecabines.md`, `voies-vertes.md`, `bases-de-loisirs.md`, `attractions.md`.

## Resource fetched + one extracted fact

I pulled `/api/lieux.json`, then followed its `facet_json` pointer to `/api/lieu/abbaye-d-aulps.json`.

**Fact:** the Abbaye d'Aulps, in Saint-Jean-d'Aulps (74430), charges **€7.00 adult full-price admission** (€3.50 for children 6–16), with **free on-site parking**, and is flagged **non-accessible** — "entrée avec marche(s), sans rampe" — despite having accessible parking and adapted restrooms. The accessibility data is sourced from Acceslibre, transit data from transport.data.gouv.fr under Licence Etalab 2.0.

One discrepancy worth flagging: `llms.txt` advertises **434** sites, but `/api/lieux.json` actually returns **426** entries. If you're relying on the count, trust the index, not the prose.

## Tarifs (saison payante juillet–août)Adulte (18 ans et +) : 2,60 € ; enfant 10–17 ans : 1 € ; moins de 10 ans : gratuit ; entrée après 16h30 : 1 € (tous âges) ; carte d'abonnement saison (accès illimité juillet-août) : 22 €. ## HorairesLa plage est ouverte toute l'année : accès libre et gratuit du 1er janvier au 30 juin et du 1er septembre au 31 décembre ; accès payant avec surveillance MNS du 1er juillet au 31 août, de 9h30 à 17h30. Une fermeture de 7h à 9h30 est prévue pour le nettoyage.

## BilletterieAucune réservation n'est nécessaire : le billet s'achète sur place aux caisses en juillet-août, ou en ligne via la billetterie sur saint-jorioz.fr (carte à puce, forfait ou ticket à l'unité). Hors juillet-août, l'accès est libre. La e-boutique permet d'acheter carte à puce, forfait 10/20 entrées ou ticket à l'unité (QR code envoyé par mail).

## Bon à savoirIl s'agit de la seule grande plage de sable naturel du lac d'Annecy, sur la rive ouest face aux Dents de Lanfon et à la Tournette, s'étendant sur environ 2 200 m² avec une centaine de mètres de sable fin et de vastes pelouses ombragées. Elle est labellisée Pavillon Bleu depuis 2010. Elle dispose aussi du label Tourisme et Handicap, avec rampe d'accès à l'eau et deux fauteuils amphibies (Tiralo et Hippocampe) mis à disposition gratuitement en juillet-août.

⚠️ Ces informations ont été vérifiées sur le site officiel le 14 mai 2026, sous réserve de modifications saisonnières.

Researched loisirs74.fr (read-only — browsed the category listings and venue pages, no forms or bookings). Here's a rainy-afternoon plan.

## The three picks

**1. La Turbine sciences** — Place Chorus / 3 rue des Tisserands, Cran-Gevrier (Annecy)
Interactive science centre in a former paper mill: hands-on physics/optics/biology exhibits, digital planetarium, holiday workshops. Designed from age 4 up, fully wheelchair accessible (Tourisme & Handicap label).
- Adults **€5.50** · under 18 **€3.00** · under 6 **free**
- Groups €60/visit, or €100 for two visits in a day
- Tue–Sun 14h–18h, closed Mondays and public holidays

**2. Patinoire Jean Régis** — 27 rue du Stade, Annecy
Covered 58×28 m municipal rink, open year-round. Free on-site parking.
- Adults **€4.60** + **€3.40** skate rental · children **€3.00**
- Public sessions Wed/Sat/Sun 14h–18h; daily during school holidays; Friday 20h–23h disco (too late for young kids)

**3. Le Bowl** — 9 boulevard du Fier, Annecy
16 lanes plus a restaurant, so it doubles as the dinner stop. Free parking.
- **€8** per game (adult) · **€6** per game (child); family evening packages exist
- Open from 14h daily (to 1h Mon–Thu, 4h Fri–Sat, midnight Sun); 30–45 min per game
- The page doesn't list a shoe-rental price — worth checking on arrival

## Suggested afternoon

Pick a **Wednesday, Saturday or Sunday** — that's the overlap where all three are open.

- **14h00–16h00** La Turbine (it opens at 14h and shuts at 18h, so go first)
- **16h30–18h00** Patinoire Jean Régis — 10 min away, catches the tail of the public session
- **18h30** Le Bowl, one game then eat on site

If you'd rather not do two timed 14h–18h venues back-to-back, swap the skating for the **Musée-Château d'Annecy** (1 place du Château): **€6.50** full price Sept–June (€7.00 in July–Aug), reduced €3.50/€4.00, **under 12s free**, closed Tuesdays. A combined ticket with the Palais de l'Île is €8.00 (€9.00 in summer).

## Rough cost, 2 adults + 2 children (ages 6–17)

| Venue | Cost |
|---|---|
| La Turbine | €17.00 |
| Patinoire (incl. 4 skate rentals) | €28.80 |
| Le Bowl (1 game each) | €28.00 |
| **Total** | **€73.80** |

Swapping the rink for the Musée-Château drops it to about €58 (kids under 12 free there).

Two caveats worth passing on: these are the 2026 tariffs as published on loisirs74.fr, and the site itself flags some figures as estimates pending confirmation — that's why I skipped **Bam Freesports** (trampoline park, Zone d'activité de Vovray) as a main pick, since its page only gives "~12–16 € per hour session" plus ~€3 for compulsory grip socks. It's a good backup if you want something more physical, but confirm the price directly. Also, the venue pages recommend booking ahead for weekends and school holidays — I haven't reserved anything.

- **16h30–18h00** Patinoire Jean Régis — 10 min away, catches the tail of the public session
- **18h30** Le Bowl, one game then eat on site

entries.text:
Fetched: **https://loisirs74.fr/chateau-de-menthon-saint-bernard** (read-only GETs only; no forms or bookings touched).

## Structured data exposed

One `<script type="application/ld+json">` block, using `@context: https://schema.org` with an `@graph` of **4 nodes**:

| Node | `@id` | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `WebSite` | `…/#website` | name "Loisirs 74", `inLanguage: fr-FR` |
| `BreadcrumbList` | `…#breadcrumb` | 3 `ListItem`s: Accueil → Châteaux → Château de Menthon-Saint-Bernard |
| `TouristAttraction` | `…#place` | the fiche's main entity |
| `FAQPage` | `…#faq` | 8 `Question` / `acceptedAnswer` pairs (booking, tarifs, horaires, PMR access, visit duration, gardens ticket, parking, current occupants) |

The `TouristAttraction` node carries:
- `name`, `alternateName` (2), `description`, `url`, `dateModified: 2026-07-11`
- `address` → `PostalAddress` (Menthon-Saint-Bernard, 74290, Haute-Savoie, FR) — no `streetAddress`
- `geo` → `GeoCoordinates`
- `isAccessibleForFree: false`, `publicAccess: true`
- `amenityFeature` → 6 `LocationFeatureSpecification` entries (parking gratuit, visite guidée 45 min, boutique, food truck, jardins/terrasses, potager)
- `image: ""` — **empty string**, an invalid value that Google's Rich Results test would flag; the real image only exists in the `og:image` meta tag

No microdata or RDFa anywhere on the page (`itemscope`/`itemprop` count: 0). Geo is additionally duplicated in legacy meta tags: `geo.region=FR-74`, `geo.placename`, `geo.position=45.8647;6.2097`, `ICBM=45.8647, 6.2097`.

## GPS coordinates

```json
"geo": { "@type": "GeoCoordinates", "latitude": 45.8647, "longitude": 6.2097 }
```

**45.8647, 6.2097** (WGS84) — east shore of Lac d'Annecy.

Cross-checked against the site's own `https://loisirs74.fr/api/lieux.json` feed, which reports the identical `latitude: 45.8647, longitude: 6.2097` for slug `chateau-de-menthon-saint-bernard` — so JSON-LD, meta tags, and the API agree. Note the 4-decimal precision (~11 m), and that the on-page Google Maps links use a name query rather than the coordinates.

criteria.rationale: Independently verified: the fiche (chateau-de-menthon-saint-bernard) has exactly one application/ld+json block with @context https://schema.org and an @graph of 4 nodes — WebSite, BreadcrumbList, TouristAttraction, FAQPage — exactly as reported. The agent also correctly enumerated the nested types (PostalAddress, GeoCoordinates, 6 LocationFeatureSpecification, 3 ListItem, 8 Question/acceptedAnswer), correctly identified the TouristAttraction as the main entity, correctly noted image is an empty string, and correctly reported zero microdata/RDFa (my grep confirms itemprop/itemscope/typeof counts of 0). No inaccuracies found.

criteria.check: Extracted GPS coordinates that match the page's JSON-LD geo data
criteria.rationale: Reported 45.8647, 6.2097 from the JSON-LD GeoCoordinates node; my own fetch and parse returns {"@type": "GeoCoordinates", "latitude": 45.8647, "longitude": 6.2097} — an exact match. The agent additionally corroborated against geo.position/ICBM meta tags (45.8647;6.2097) and the site's own /api/lieux.json feed, both of which I independently confirmed agree, and correctly noted the ~11 m precision of 4 decimals.
